segmented.$description: v0.7 — Segmented control. 2–4 mutually exclusive options on one row. The 'tabs but for control' pattern. Built on <button> elements (NOT radio inputs — RadioGroup owns that). One bar surface; active item lifts above with a subtle shadow.

bar.$description: The container that holds all segments.

height.$description: 32 px — denser than full inputs because it lives next to other controls.

padding.$description: Outer pad is 2 px applied as a 0.5 utility — inner segments handle their own padding.

segment.$description: A single button inside the bar. Active segment fills with surface.raised + shadow.xs to lift above its peers.

hover.$description: Hover is signaled via color shift on the inactive label, not bg.

active.$description: Subtle lift to read above the bar.
